name: Yann Vonlanthen
description: Yann Vonlanthen is a researcher on the Ethereum Foundation’s protocol research team, where he works on fast finality and consensus networking. He completed his PhD at ETH Zurich, where his research focused on Byzantine fault tolerance, blockchain networking, and decentralized governance. His work has appeared at venues including USENIX Security, Middleware, and AFT, and received the Middleware 2024 Best Paper Award.
